classification.label: Operating model
classification.value: Collateral-backed instant funding with performance-based progression
classification.note: FOXIFY presents FUNDED as an A-book infrastructure layer integrated into live decentralized trading venues rather than a conventional evaluation product.

summary.label: How the model works
summary.value: A trader deposits USDC collateral, receives a larger FUNDED balance immediately, trades on supported DEX order books, and advances through capital levels after meeting both the points and profit targets.

lifecycle.label: 1 · Deposit
lifecycle.value: Choose a supported venue and deposit 100 USDC for Entry or 500 USDC for Pro; the documented Elite route also uses 500 USDC but is marked coming soon.

lifecycle.label: 2 · Instant activation
lifecycle.value: Receive live FUNDED capital without an evaluation phase: $500 on Entry, $2,500 on Pro, or $5,000 on the future Elite track.

lifecycle.label: 3 · Trade
lifecycle.value: Trade on supported decentralized venues while staying inside the level-specific maximum drawdown.

lifecycle.label: 4 · Hit both targets
lifecycle.value: Promotion requires 100 points and the level profit target, documented as 15% of the level's initial FUNDED balance.

lifecycle.label: 5 · Cash out and scale
lifecycle.value: The standard track pays 80% of eligible profit in USDC through on-chain settlement and advances the trader to the next level.

accountEnvironment.label: Account environment
accountEnvironment.value: Real capital routed to live DEX order books

traderPayment.label: Trader payment
traderPayment.value: Refundable-risk collateral is deposited in USDC and can be consumed by losses or inactivity-related borrow fees.
traderPayment.note: The sources describe the deposit as collateral rather than an evaluation fee; complete refund mechanics are not documented in the research set.

fundingMechanism.label: Funding mechanism
fundingMechanism.value: FOXIFY vault capital expands the trader's usable balance and absorbs losses beyond the deposited collateral, subject to each level's maximum drawdown.

traderCompensation.label: Trader compensation
traderCompensation.value: 80% of eligible profit on standard FUNDED accounts; 70% on Automated FUNDED beta accounts.

capital.notes: Entry and Pro currently scale to $10,000. Elite is documented up to $20,000 but marked coming soon.

entryCost.notes: Entry requires 100 USDC; Pro requires 500 USDC; Elite is documented at 500 USDC but is not live.

profitSplit.notes: The separate waitlist page mentions up to 90%; current documentation is used for the displayed current range.

maxDrawdown.notes: Calculated from the initial FUNDED balance of each level.

payoutSchedules.notes: Standard payouts are described as instant USDC settlement after eligibility conditions are met.

sections.title: Collateral-backed funding infrastructure
sections.description: FOXIFY's product model is organized around live execution, collateral and level-by-level scaling rather than evaluation phases.

blocks.title: FUNDED by FOXIFY
paragraphs: FOXIFY describes FUNDED as an A-book prop-firm infrastructure layer that trading platforms can integrate. A trader supplies USDC collateral and receives a larger live trading balance immediately; every documented FUNDED trade is presented as routed through real DEX order books.

Revenue is described as coming from trading fees and the protocol profit share. Trader losses first reduce the deposited collateral, while the protocol vault covers losses beyond that collateral within the account's permitted drawdown.

blocks.text: The current documentation contains inconsistent minimum-time wording: the Points section says there is no minimum trading time, while the restrictions summary lists a one-day minimum. Keep both statements unresolved until the live product rule is manually confirmed.

items.label: 1 · Eligibility
items.value: Reach 100 points and the current level's profit target

items.label: 2 · Request cashout
items.value: Eligible profit can be requested without a documented manual-review stage

items.label: 3 · Apply split
items.value: 80% to the trader and 20% to FOXIFY on standard accounts

items.label: 4 · Settlement
items.value: USDC is sent on-chain to the connected wallet and the account advances to the next level

blocks.title: Automated FUNDED
paragraphs: Automated FUNDED deploys the account balance into curated strategy vaults and automates execution, cashout and scaling. Entry and Pro are described as available during beta; Elite automation remains in development.

Automated accounts use a 70% trader / 30% protocol split instead of the standard 80% / 20%. Published performance statistics are marketing-reported observations and should be rechecked before production comparison filters use them.

blocks.text: Current official pages publish different market counts: documentation lists 125+ for active integrations, while the main website advertises 220+. The site should preserve venue-specific values instead of presenting one universal market count.

blocks.title: NotebookLM-assisted profile · 2026-08-22
paragraphs: The current documentation is the primary basis for the model, levels and mechanics. The main website is retained for current marketing claims and surfaced discrepancies.

The v2 waitlist and seven-day Trade2Earn page are preserved only as historical product context. Their 90% split, Flash Funding language, seven-day qualification and much larger capital claims are not merged into the current FUNDED offer.
